caption: Stadhuis, Zierikzee
composition: Stone town hall and octagonal tower from the Meelstraat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Stadhuis at Zierikzee is a stone-fronted town hall with an octagonal brick tower, an open lantern, and a pear-shaped crown. A small Neptune figure finishes the spire and is not a separate monument. It is overcast, about 15.3°C, with wind near 8.3 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The museum is closed. The portrait medallions are not readable. The Noordhavenpoort and the Sint-Lievensmonstertoren are other scenes and are not in this frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Stadhuis in Zierikzee at night

qc_notes.note: Gate 1 hold (Cosmo QC 2026-09-26, verified by Cosmo's own read of both masters): the two format masters disagree on the town-hall front — the 16:9 shows a stone-clad front with two ornate gables (six arched bays, central portal), while the 4:5 shows a single-gable front with one central gable, round oculus and arched portal, centered on the tower. The card's own geometry anchor 2 requires 'a stone-clad front with two gables', which matches the 16:9 and contradicts the 4:5. The octagonal tower with open lantern and pear-shaped crown agrees across both formats, but the fronts are materially different compositions, not a viewpoint difference (each is shown symmetrically head-on). Builder to align the 16:9/4:5 renders and re-push; approval awaits corrected masters.
